Class BistroServerGUIController

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.controller.BistroServerGUIController
public class BistroServerGUIController extends Object
JavaFX controller for the Bistro server GUI.

This controller manages a TableView that displays currently known client connections (typically OCSF ConnectionToClient instances). Each row is represented by a ClientConnection model containing the client's id, IP address and a human-readable status.

Lifecycle: the initialize() method is invoked automatically by the JavaFX FXMLLoader after the FXML fields are injected. It initializes the observable list, binds it to the table view, and configures the table columns.

Threading note: JavaFX UI updates must run on the JavaFX Application Thread. If the server notifies connection events from a background thread, wrap calls to addNewConnection(ConnectionToClient) and editConnection(ConnectionToClient) using Platform.runLater(...).

    • addNewConnection

      public void addNewConnection(com.lloseng.ocsf.server.ConnectionToClient client)
      Adds a new connected client row to the table.

      The created row uses the client's id and InetAddress. The default status is set to "Open".

      Parameters:
      client - the connected OCSF client

    • editConnection

      public void editConnection(com.lloseng.ocsf.server.ConnectionToClient client)
      Updates an existing connection row to mark it as closed.

      This method finds the row by client id and sets its status to "closed". After updating, the table view is refreshed to ensure the UI reflects the change.

      Parameters:
      client - the client whose connection status should be updated
